feedback: The candidate's performance shows significant room for improvement. The robot experienced 2 line loss events and a maximum error of 0.060533, indicating instability in line tracking. The current kp value of 0.7, while an improvement, may still be insufficient for optimal responsiveness. Additionally, the sensor weights could be further adjusted to enhance the effectiveness of the center sensor. I recommend increasing kp to 0.8 to improve responsiveness and reducing the side sensor weights to 0.8 to further prioritize the center sensor. This should help in reducing line loss events and improving overall tracking stability.
